title: Salesforce (CRM) Earns Vote of Confidence from Truist after $3.6 Billion Acquisition
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 在以 36 亿美元收购后赢得 Truist 的信任票
summary: With a free cash flow yield of 11.07%, Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) is included among the 12 Stocks From Companies Generating High Cash Flow. On June 15, Truist maintained its Buy rating on Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM). It also set a $280 price target on the stock.
summary_zh: Salesforce, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：CRM）的自由现金流收益率为 11.07%，被列入产生高现金流公司的 12 只股票之一。 6 月 15 日，Truist 维持对 Salesforce, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：CRM）的买入评级。它还为该股设定了...

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures edge up after US and Iran sign interim deal
title_zh: 今日股市：美国和伊朗签署临时协议后，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货小幅上涨
summary: US stock futures edged up as Wall Street digested the interim peace deal between the US and Iran as well as the latest Federal Reserve decision on interest rates.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街消化美国和伊朗之间的临时和平协议以及美联储最新的利率决定，美国股指期货小幅上涨。

title: Morgan Stanley enters U.K. rental market with $1.4B acquisition
title_zh: 摩根士丹利以 1.4B 美元收购进入英国租赁市场
summary: Morgan Stanley’s real estate investing arm is now a landlord to 3,200 London households. The deal closes an 18-month sale process that began when one of England’s largest housing associations decided market-rate rentals no longer fit its mission.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利的房地产投资部门现在是 3,200 个伦敦家庭的房东。该交易结束了为期 18 个月的销售流程，该流程始于英格兰最大的住房协会之一认为市场租金不再适合其使命。

title: Oracle Disputes Report on Failed Microsoft Cloud Deal
title_zh: 甲骨文关于失败的微软云交易的争议报告
summary: Oracle said details in a report about failed cloud deal talks with Microsoft were inaccurate.
summary_zh: 甲骨文表示，一份有关与微软失败的云交易谈判的报告中的细节不准确。

title: Microsoft Walks Away From Potential $3 Billion Oracle Deal, Stock Dips

summary: Microsoft Halts Oracle Data Center Talks in Major Security-Driven Split
summary_zh: 微软因安全驱动的重大分歧而暂停甲骨文数据中心谈判
